about:
ImpactPro Parts Inc operates from Hyattsville, Maryland. The business began as a small warehouse in Beltsville, Maryland, before relocating to its current Hyattsville facility in 2001. A management change in 2018 brought process upgrades and an expanded delivery network reaching the Baltimore area.

The company distributes aftermarket collision parts and body shop supplies to auto repair shops across the DMV region. Its inventory spans domestic and foreign vehicle collision parts—including fenders, bumpers, headlamps, radiators, and structural components—as well as body shop materials such as clear coats, primers, adhesion promoters, body fillers, sandpaper, and dent pullers. The firm also stocks a selection of tools and continues to add products based on availability and demand.

Customers include independent body shops and collision repair centers throughout Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, with recent delivery expansion into Baltimore. The company notes a culturally diverse clientele, supported by a fully bilingual (Spanish-English) female customer service team that has helped grow its Hispanic customer base.

ImpactPro Parts emphasizes exact-fit parts availability, competitive pricing, and timely delivery as its core differentiators. The company cites its diverse workforce and bilingual staff as drivers of innovation and adaptability, aiming to streamline the parts procurement process for shops completing auto body projects.
